parent_objective: materialize overlay-only static config-patch artifacts from M2377 design and M2375 repair-plan artifacts
blocked_by: M2377 designs overlay-only config patches but does not materialize them
active config overwrite and repair execution remain blocked until patch artifacts are materialized and audited
supersedes: direct active config overwrite after application design
direct repair execution or training from repair-plan artifacts

public_gates: M2378 must materialize overlay-only config-patch artifacts from M2375 repair-plan outputs and M2377 design
M2378 must preserve active-config overwrite, actor-input, oracle-feature, profile-tuning, collision, R4, diagnostic, and mixed guarded constraints
M2378 must not run reset rollout measured execution repair execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes overlay-only static config-patch artifacts from repair-plan artifacts without applying repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: artifact-only config-patch materialization; no repair execution, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if active config overwrite occurs
stop if patch target namespace is not overlay-only
stop if guardrail constraints are missing
stop if any forbidden execution or claim flag is set
fallback_plan: route to result/failure audit for any artifact mismatch
route to application design repair if overlay schema is insufficient
route to M2379 result audit if gates pass

admission_evidence: M2377 defines overlay-only config-patch schema and pass gates
allowed_updates: M2378 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2378 materializes config-patch artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history or finite-window-vs-GRU verdict is run in M2378.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2375 repair-plan artifacts, M2376 audit, and M2377 application design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Config-patch artifacts remain engineering design artifacts and cannot be interpreted as driver capability improvements.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds overlay config-patch artifacts from repair-plan route but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit config-patch result audit but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2378 produces config-patch artifacts but no result audit route
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Artifact-only materialization can turn repair-plan artifacts into overlay config-patch artifacts without active config overwrite, repair execution, ranking, or training-success claims.
success_criteria: actor_input_change_count hidden_oracle_feature_injection_count profile_specific_tuning_count ranking_admissible_count winner_selected_count are 0
environment_rollout_started policy_action_executed repair_execution_started training_started replay_started ppo_used are false
paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU level3 self-ID scenario-redesign-executed training-repair-success and current-sim verdict claims are false
failure_criteria: any required output family is missing
patch artifacts include actor input changes hidden/oracle features profile-specific tuning ranking or winner selection
any forbidden execution or claim flag is set
decision_rule: M2378 passes if it materializes overlay config-patch artifacts without active config overwrite, repair execution, ranking, training, or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims.
